title: pdp_bq
description: `pdp_bq` is a spatial biquad filter with low-pass, high-pass, all-pass, and band-stop modes, plus selectable horizontal and vertical filtering directions. Its right inlet sets the number of passes; frequency is normalized between 0 and 1, with 0.5 representing Nyquist, and frequency or Q values outside sensible ranges can produce unstable behavior.
